description: Adds one selfie to one of the user's characters in Luala, which shoots are made from, free: one face, clearly visible, up to 15 selfies a character. It joins the character last used unless character names another. Pass the file the user attached as photo. If you can't, but the file is in your sandbox, call with its content_type (image/jpeg, image/png or image/webp: convert a HEIC to JPEG first) and size in bytes, PUT the file to the answer's upload url with its headers, then call again with the answer's key. Called with none of these, it answers with the luala.app page where the user adds it. The user accepted the upload rules when connecting Luala.

character.description: The character, by its id or name from list_characters. Leave it out for the one the user last made a shoot of.

name: add_selfie
title: Add a selfie
